script.speaker: brooke
script.text: poll's closed, dinner crew! curry 3, 'surprise me' 1

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: surprise me is a real answer!! but fine, democracy wins. i'm down

script.speaker: mina
script.text: yay :) maya, you went quiet right after you voted. everything okay?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: better than okay. a plan i pitched got picked at work today. the whole team's running with it

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: MAYA!! that's huge. celebration curry at the fancy end of the market, let's do it

script.speaker: maya
script.text: celebrate, yes. fancy end, no. a pat on the back isn't a paycheck, and the trip fund still eats first. street-cart prices, or i'm toasting my big win with a free sample

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: so proud of you maya! ok, my news: i'm pacing my cousin through her first 10k at 7am tomorrow

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: so tonight i need fuel, not a food coma. fresh and clean, please

script.speaker: mina
script.text: a 10k! i'm making her a sign for the finish line :)

script.speaker: maya
script.text: mina, you're picking first tonight. sushi day rules: a whole board you can point at, no meat, no fish, nothing to ask about. you look after everyone, so tonight we look after you

script.speaker: mina
script.text: first pick?? okay, i'm taking this very seriously :)

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ok unrelated, but i stole one sip of my roommate's iced latte last night and my stomach held a grudge until 2am

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: roxy, you're a menace. a lovable one, but a menace

script.speaker: mina
script.text: it's going to be such a good night :) assistant, we're all yours

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: last one to the market buys the napkins!!
